ValidationRule.description: Payment term is not required for Montreal order type DR, CR
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISPICKVAL(Site__c, "Montreal"),ISPICKVAL(SFDC_Integration_Status__c, 'In Progress'), ISPICKVAL( Order_Type__c , "Credit Memo Request") && NOT( ISBLANK(PaymentTerm__c ))) || AND(ISPICKVAL(Site__c, "Montreal"),ISPICKVAL(SFDC_Integration_Status__c, 'In Progress'), ISPICKVAL( Order_Type__c , "Debit Memo/Bill only Request") && NOT( ISBLANK(PaymentTerm__c )))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Payment term is not required for selected Site and Order Type combination.
